excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026美加墨世界杯开赛在即。今日，千问举办首个足球预测AI助手上线沙龙。邀请用户预测比分赢积分，参与用户不仅能与千问一起为乡村学校捐出足球场，还有机会赢下万元现金大奖。   千问上线足球预测AI助手 上线首个足球预测AI助手 融合天气、地貌等大数据 这是AI全面参与竞猜的首届足球世界杯。此次千问上线足球预测 AI 助手，向所有用户开放。千问AI预测产品负责人程飞介绍，该足球预测AI助手基于海量大数据训练，不仅包括历史数据、各国足球运动员数据、受伤情况等，甚至还包括美加墨地貌数据及比赛期间天气数据。 程飞以6月22日小组赛挪威对阵塞内加尔为例，拥有世界级前锋哈兰德的挪威，取胜似乎显而易见。但千问却给出了“1:1平局”的预测结果。 “给出这个预测的原因是天气，”程飞介绍道：“因为今年世界杯由三个国家承办，不同比赛可能面临的天气情况完全不同。千问会去关注比赛举办地的气温、湿度、开球时间，以及两支球队长期习惯的比赛环境。”同样受天气和海拔影响的还有此次揭幕战墨西哥对阵南非，千问给出的预测是，墨西哥获胜，不仅仅是基于东道主优势，还有比赛地墨西哥城超过2200米海拔的特殊因素。  千问AI预测产品负责人程飞介绍千问足球预测 AI 助手 千问的准确性如何？面对这个问题，程飞认为，已经做了最大程度的优化，但足球最大的魅力就在于不可预测。“如果有人告诉你，他能100%预测比赛结果，那他大概率不是AI，而是骗子。” 大模型预测能否战胜人类？2026年美加墨比赛期间，千问将与用户展开持续互动，并送出大奖。 在全部104场比赛中，只要用户在千问参与竞猜，预测超80场且准确率超过千问，就有机会参与抽取1万元大奖，共设100个名额。千问方面称：鼓励中奖者全国观赛，支持苏超、浙超、粤超、村超等。 此外，参与预测超32场，用户即可获得“参与奖”抽奖机会，奖品为1000副千问AI眼镜G
excerpt_i18n.en:
The 2026 FIFA World Cup in the USA, Canada, and Mexico is approaching. Today, Qianwen held the launch salon for its first football prediction AI assistant. Users are invited to predict scores to earn points. Participants can not only help Qianwen donate football fields to rural schools but also have a chance to win a cash prize of 10,000 yuan.  

Qianwen Launches Football Prediction AI Assistant  
The first football prediction AI assistant has been launched, integrating big data such as weather and terrain. This is the first World Cup where AI fully participates in match predictions. Qianwen’s football prediction AI assistant is now open to all users. Cheng Fei, head of Qianwen’s AI prediction products, explained that the assistant is trained on massive datasets, including historical data, player statistics, injury reports, and even terrain data of the USA, Canada, and Mexico, as well as weather data during match periods.  

Using the example of the group stage match between Norway and Senegal on June 22, Cheng Fei noted that Norway, with world-class striker Erling Haaland, seems likely to win. However, Qianwen predicted a 1-1 draw.  

“The reason for this prediction is the weather,” Cheng Fei explained. “Since this World Cup is hosted by three countries, matches may face completely different weather conditions. Qianwen considers factors such as temperature, humidity, kickoff time, and the typical playing environments of both teams.” Similarly, weather and altitude affect the opening match between Mexico and South Africa. Qianwen predicts a Mexican victory, not only due to home-field advantage but also because of the special factor of Mexico City’s altitude of over 2,200 meters.
excerpt_i18n.es: La Copa del Mundo de 2026, que se celebrará en Estados Unidos, México y Canadá, está a punto de comenzar. Hoy, Qianwen organiza el primer evento de lanzamiento de su asistente de IA para predicciones futbolísticas. Invita a los usuarios a predecir resultados y ganar puntos. Los participantes no solo podrán contribuir con Qianwen a donar campos de fútbol a escuelas rurales, sino que también tendrán la oportunidad de ganar un premio en efectivo de diez mil yuanes. Qianwen lanza su asistente de IA para predicciones futbolísticas, el primero de su tipo, que integra macrodatos como el clima y la topografía. Esta es la primera Copa del Mundo de fútbol en la que la IA participa plenamente en las apuestas. Qianwen ha puesto a disposición de todos los usuarios este asistente de IA para predicciones futbolísticas. Cheng Fei, responsable del producto de predicciones de IA de Qianwen, explicó que el asistente se basa en el entrenamiento con enormes cantidades de macrodatos, que incluyen no solo datos históricos, sino también diversos factores.

Recently, HiDream.ai launched its new commercial image generation model, HiDream-O1-Image-1.5, which has once again achieved SOTA. On the Text to Image Leaderboard of Artificial Analysis, a globally renowned independent AI model evaluation and analysis platform, it ranked first among Chinese image generation models, becoming the only Chinese large model company with a score second only to OpenAI. It surpassed mainstream image generation models from major domestic and international companies, including Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview), NVIDIA Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image, and ByteDance’s Seedream 4.0.  

Two weeks ago, HiDream.ai’s open-source model, HiDream-O1-Image-Dev-2604 from the HiDream-O1 series, topped the open-source model category on the text-to-image leaderboard globally. Just weeks later, HiDream-O1-Image-1.5 has once again entered the top three of the global text-to-image large model leaderboard. This consecutive achievement not only confirms HiDream.ai’s robust capabilities in image generation large models but also marks its solid position in the global first tier of the visual generation large model competition.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, el nuevo modelo comercial de generación de imágenes HiDream-O1-Image-1.5, lanzado por Zhixiang Future (HiDream.ai), ha alcanzado nuevamente el estado del arte (SOTA). En el ranking Text to Image Leaderboard de la reconocida plataforma global independiente de evaluación y análisis de modelos de IA, Artificial Analysis, se ha posicionado como el primer modelo chino de generación de imágenes, convirtiéndose en la empresa china de modelos grandes con la puntuación más alta solo superada por OpenAI, superando a Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Im).

items.raw_excerpt: 6月10日，阿里巴巴合伙人委员会在公司内网发布帖文《有情有义有成长，才是阿里文化》，对近日钉钉前产品经理离职长文《置身钉内》引发的讨论表达了清晰的态度。帖文以严厉的措辞批评了钉钉团队的管理方式，直接指出这"不是阿里文化该有的样子"。    在批评之外，合伙人委员会的帖文阐述了阿里文化应当坚持的方向。"相互尊重，视人为人，有情有义"是阿里的文化底色，"无论时代如何改变，技术如何发展"，底色都一定不能改变。   此前，钉钉的管理风格曾多次引发外部讨论。合伙人组织进行了认真讨论并形成一致判断，强调"无论什么情况下，无论任务多么紧迫"都不应该出现这种管理，“这不是阿里文化倡导的方向”。   帖文指出，AI时代创新依靠的不是"高压和机械执行"，而是员工的热爱和创造力，只有充分尊重员工个体价值，才能真正创造客户价值。管理者的职责是"远见、主动担当、团结和激励团队"，"培养人激发人是每个leader的责任"。AI 时代，人是最宝贵的财富，更需要坚持有情有义，培育开放、包容、多元的工作文化。     ———————— 附：阿里内网帖原文 《有情有义有成长，才是阿里文化》   各位同学：   这几天，公司合伙人组织关注到内网《置身钉内》在内外部引发的讨论，合伙人也就钉钉目前团队文化做了认真讨论。大家一致认为，无论什么情况下，无论任务多么紧迫，都不应该出现帖子中所提到的钉钉团队这种管理方式。这种方式从来都不是阿里文化倡导的方向，不是阿里文化该有的样子。   阿里人聚在一起，是因为彼此信任，一起做成一些有意义有价值的事。相互尊重、视人为人、有情有义，是我们的文化底色。无

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 10, the Alibaba Partnership Committee posted an article on the company's internal network titled "Compassion, Growth, and Integrity: The Essence of Alibaba Culture," clearly addressing the discussions sparked by a recent resignation letter from a former DingTalk product manager, "Inside DingTalk." Previously, DingTalk's management style had sparked external discussions multiple times. The partnership committee conducted a thorough discussion and reached a unanimous judgment, emphasizing that "under no circumstances, no matter how urgent the task," should such management occur, and "this is not the direction Alibaba culture advocates." The post noted that in the AI era, innovation relies not on "pressure and mechanical execution" but on employees' passion and creativity. Only by fully respecting the individual value of employees can true customer value be created. Managers' responsibilities are "vision, proactive accountability, uniting and motivating the team," and "cultivating and inspiring people is the duty of every leader." In the AI era, people remain the core.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de junio, el Comité de Socios de Alibaba publicó en la red interna de la empresa un artículo titulado "Con sentimiento, justicia y crecimiento, esa es la cultura de Alibaba", expresando una postura clara ante el debate generado por la reciente carta de renuncia del exgerente de producto de DingTalk, titulada "Dentro de Ding". El artículo criticó con dureza la gestión del equipo de DingTalk, señalando directamente que "no es la forma que debería tener la cultura de Alibaba". Además de las críticas, el artículo del Comité de Socios expuso la dirección que debe mantener la cultura de Alibaba. "Respeto mutuo, tratar a las personas como personas, con sentimiento y justicia" es la base cultural de Alibaba, "sin importar cómo cambien los tiempos".
